The Hillsborough disaster in 1989 tragically claimed 97 lives. Subsequent investigations revealed police failings and the spread of false narratives. This bill seeks to prevent such cover-ups by legally obligating public officials to be truthful.

This law represents a significant victory for victims and families, ensuring a legal framework for truth and accountability that can prevent future injustices.
